<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <Description>
      The official .NET library for performing CRUD opertations on Agents in Microsoft Foundry.

      This library features the client to perform Agent administration operations. It depends on and builds from the official OpenAI library for .NET to maintain rapid upstream feature propagation and
      ongoing forward compatibility.
    </Description>
    <AssemblyTitle>Microsoft Azure.AI.Projects.Agents client library</AssemblyTitle>
    <Version>3.0.0-beta.6</Version>
    <!--The ApiCompatVersion is managed automatically and should not generally be modified manually.-->
    <ApiCompatVersion>2.0.0</ApiCompatVersion>
    <PackageTags>Azure.AI.Projects.Agents</PackageTags>
    <TargetFrameworks>$(RequiredTargetFrameworks)</TargetFrameworks>
    <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile>
    <IncludeOperationsSharedSource>true</IncludeOperationsSharedSource>
    <IncludeSystemClientModelSharedSourceForTracing>true</IncludeSystemClientModelSharedSourceForTracing>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="OpenAI" />
    <PackageReference Include="Azure.Core" />
    <PackageReference Include="Azure.AI.Extensions.OpenAI" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)ExperimentalAttribute.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
